import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on Mouse ID
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Pivot: create columns for each Drug with mean Tumor Volume per Timepoint
pivot = joined.pivot_table(index="Timepoint", columns="Drug", values="Tumor Volume (mm3)", aggfunc="mean")

# Reset index to bring Timepoint back as a column
pivot = pivot.reset_index()

# The target schema columns (except Timepoint) are drug names, some may be missing in pivot columns
target_cols = ['Timepoint', 'Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol', 
               'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Ensure all target drug columns exist, fill missing with NaN
for col in target_cols[1:]:
    if col not in pivot.columns:
        pivot[col] = pd.NA

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
pivot = pivot[target_cols]

# Write output
pivot.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_61/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
